layout_architecture.navigation: Sticky top bar with custom monogram SVG logo, interactive nav links (Projects, Experience, Paint-Resume, Contact), theme/fluid toggle button, and Quick Contact CTA.
layout_architecture.hero_section: Masked line-by-line staggered reveal using Framer Motion. Headlines highlighting CS Student @ Bridgewater State & IT Intern @ Steptoe LLP with live status badge.
layout_architecture.bento_grid: Asymmetric bento grid showcasing 3 main featured projects + Lightnata Flutter prototype with live preview modals, links, and asset cards.
layout_architecture.experience_skills: Dual-tab/interactive timeline showing Steptoe LLP IT Intern AI & Data, Bridgewater State CS, and Roblox Dev milestones alongside tagged tech stack pills.
layout_architecture.resume_paint_section: Interactive 'Paint-it-Full' resume reveal canvas with reset button, view full modal, and instant PDF download trigger.
layout_architecture.contact_section: Modern high-contrast contact form with form validation, local storage fallback, copy email/discord buttons, and direct social links.
layout_architecture.footer: Editorial dark footer with live clock, location (Bridgewater, MA), custom logo, and back-to-top scroll button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are built in JS format (.js or .jsx) in accordance with the project structure.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or native fluid motion handlers without scroll jank.
Provide a robust fall-back canvas for the WebGL fluid simulation in case WebGL context fails on low-end devices.
Ensure all buttons and interactive cards feature visible focus rings and accessible data-testid attributes.
Clean up the stock splash page in App.js completely and replace with the main portfolio layout.
